section_1.title: Prerequisite: The Pulse of Time
section_1.content: Establish the concept of 'Beat' as a constant, periodic unit of time. Introduce the visual representation of beats as equidistant dots on a timeline.
section_1.example: A metronome ticking steadily or a robotic drum-bot tapping its foot at a constant speed.

section_2.title: The Concept of Measures (Bars)
section_2.content: Introduce 'Measures' as containers that group beats. Explain the 'Bar Line' as a vertical wall that divides the infinite timeline into manageable chunks.
section_2.example: Think of a conveyor belt carrying boxes. Each box (measure) contains exactly 4 rhythmic items (beats) before the next box begins.

section_3.title: Decoding the Time Signature
section_3.content: Explain the fraction-like notation (e.g., 4/4). Top number = beats per measure; Bottom number = note value of the beat. Use a pie-chart animation to show how a whole note splits into parts.
section_3.example: In 4/4 time, imagine a hungry caterpillar that must eat exactly 4 'leaf-beats' before moving to the next segment of the branch.

section_4.title: Dynamic Application: The Accent Pattern
section_4.content: Explain how measure theory creates hierarchy. Beat 1 is always the 'strong' beat (the downbeat). Visualize this with a bouncing ball—the first bounce is highest.
section_4.example: A marching band: The 'LEFT-right-left-right' pattern is dictated by the measure, where the first step is emphasized to keep the squad synchronized.

section_5.title: Summary and Synthesis
section_5.content: Recap: Beats provide the pulse, measures provide the structure, and time signatures act as the mathematical blueprint. Challenge students to identify the time signature of a short auditory clip.
section_5.example: A snippet of a waltz (3/4) vs. a rock beat (4/4) visualized as repeating geometric shapes: triangles (3 beats) vs. squares (4 beats).

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.2 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Concept of Measures (Bars)", ["Measures group beats into containers.", "Bar lines divide the rhythm.", "Each box holds steady beats."])
        
        # --- Elements ---
        measure_box = Rectangle(width=4.0, height=1.5, color=WHITE)
        bar_lines = VGroup(
            Line(UP * 0.75, DOWN * 0.75, color="#00FFFF"),
            Line(UP * 0.75, DOWN * 0.75, color="#00FFFF"),
            Line(UP * 0.75, DOWN * 0.75, color="#00FFFF")
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1.0)
        
        beats = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.2, color="#FF8000", fill_opacity=1) for _ in range(4)])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.place_in_area(measure_box, 'B2', 'D5', scale_factor=1.0)))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Position bar lines inside the box
        center_area = self.grid['C3']
        bar_lines.move_to(center_area)
        self.play(Create(bar_lines))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        beats.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).move_to(center_area)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(b) for b in beats], lag_ratio=0.2))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF8000")
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.2 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject
